verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26996855 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318611 (dated 2026-01-13). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 10,000 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-02-10. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: Delivery terms look inconsistent: the document says EXW Boise and 'DDP is not agreed', but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so the buyer should confirm what will be invoiced.
The unit of measure for the quantity is not stated.
The document carries no issue date of its own; only the PO date (2026-01-13) is given.
observations: No handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs are visible.
The description wraps across three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
